findings.title: get_vps_proxy_health / get_vps_service_health: off-hours classification masks genuinely-stale market-hours-only sources
findings.root_cause: vpsProxyTools.ts: isStale() already computes a window-relative grace-adjusted threshold (minutesSinceLastWindowEnd()+30min via freshnessSlaChecker.ts) and correctly returns true for 'prices' today (~36h stale vs ~6.5h grace threshold). But formatHealth()'s isServiceOffHours() re-applies a cruder 'is it market hours right now' wall-clock check on TOP of that result and unconditionally excludes any off-hours-stale service from trueStaleServices/the STALE alert line -- double-applying grace that isStale() already spent, converting a real 36h outage into a silently-excluded 'OFF-HOURS (by design)' line. vpsHealthPoller.ts has a purer version of the same bug class: checkServiceFreshness() short-circuits to healthStatus='idle' for any marketHoursOnly service whenever nowIso is outside 02:00-08:30 UTC, with ZERO window-relative check at all -- confirmed live: vps_service_health shows vn-price-fetch=idle and vn-foreign-flow=idle right now even though both have been dead since 2026-07-21 03:08 UTC.
findings.live_evidence: docker exec into vn-market-intelligence-mcp-mcp-server-1, bun:sqlite read-only query against /app/data/market.db at 2026-07-22T16:00:07Z: vps_service_health shows vn-price-fetch=idle, vn-foreign-flow=idle (both correct per current code, both masking a 36h+ dead pipe). market_prices/daily_foreign_flow/vps_push_log all confirm zero prices/foreign-flow activity since 2026-07-21 ~03:08 UTC.
findings.proposed_fix: vpsProxyTools.ts: remove the unconditional 'if (isServiceOffHours(s)) return false;' veto inside trueStaleServices -- since isStale() already embeds off-hours grace, any isStale()===true result (off-hours or not) is a real breach and belongs in the STALE line; reserve the off-hours label for isStale()===false. vpsHealthPoller.ts: replace the unconditional marketHoursOnly idle short-circuit with a window-relative check (mirror lastExpectedWindowEnd()/minutesSinceLastWindowEnd() from freshnessSlaChecker.ts) -- only return idle when latestAt is within grace of the most-recently-closed window; otherwise run the normal ageMs>maxAgeMs check.
findings.test_impact_warning: Broad existing test coverage on this off-hours/grace logic (234-vps-health-sla.test.ts, FIX-SLA-WEEKEND-AWARE.test.ts, FIX-BCTC-SLA-WEEKEND.test.ts, 1920i-freshness-sla-extension.test.ts, and others) -- some may currently assert the old (masking) behavior and need review alongside the fix, not just the two files above.

findings.title: get_vps_service_health reports vn-sbv-fetch=healthy while VPS push has been dead 36h+ -- local fallback job and VPS push share one un-discriminated table row
findings.root_cause: sbv_rates has PRIMARY KEY(source) -- single row per source, INSERT OR REPLACE. BOTH the VPS push handler (interface/mcp/routes/pushSbvRatesHandler.ts) and the local server-side fallback job (scheduler/macro/sbvRatesJob.ts, runs every 4h, fetches a VCB rate independently of the VPS) call the exact same storeSbvSnapshot() with the identical hardcoded source='sbv'. There is no column distinguishing which writer produced the current row. vpsHealthPoller.ts's vn-sbv-fetch freshness check queries 'SELECT MAX(fetched_at) FROM sbv_rates' with no is_estimate filter, so every ~4h the local fallback silently refreshes fetched_at regardless of whether the real VPS push is alive -- confirmed live: sbv_rates currently has exactly ONE row, is_estimate=1 (proves it's the local fallback, not a real VPS push), fetched_at=2026-07-22T16:00:04Z (seconds before this signal), while vps_push_log for service='sbv' has zero rows since 2026-07-21 03:05:21 (36h+). get_vps_proxy_health reads vps_push_log directly (written only by the VPS handler) and correctly shows 36h+ stale -- the two tools disagree because they measure two structurally different tables, one of which has an undisclosed second writer.
findings.live_evidence: docker exec query: sbv_rates = [{source:'sbv', usd_vnd_official:26120, fetched_at:'2026-07-22T16:00:04.272Z', is_estimate:1}] (only row in the table). vps_push_log service='sbv': MAX(pushed_at) where status='ok' = 2026-07-21 03:05:21.
findings.proposed_fix: Add 'WHERE is_estimate = 0' to the vn-sbv-fetch latestTimestampSql in vpsHealthPoller.ts's DEFAULT_FRESHNESS_CONFIGS, mirroring how vn-news-fetch's config already reads vps_push_log directly instead of an ambiguous shared table. This makes get_vps_service_health blind to the local fallback's writes without touching the fallback job itself (scheduler/macro/sbvRatesJob.ts is a legitimate degrade-gracefully mechanism for end users and is out of scope -- it is under scheduler/* and not part of this signal's ask).
